rules: Each released migration step is listed here with the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 SQL; a released step never changes (forward-only, 13-distribution-updates section 6).

Steps are consecutive from version 1. Within a release, steps are expand-only; tests/ArcForges.Node.Store.Tests checks every consecutive pair with SchemaDiff (the CI step 'Check the node store schema is expand-only').
A contract step (drop or rename) is released only after min_reader_version excludes every version still eligible as a rollback target, and raises minReaderVersion.
